name: Campo Grande
scopeLimits: This is city-source research, not a boundary or completeness assertion. No owner, address, tax, account, or other personal property data were requested or retained. No authentication, CAPTCHA, applicant form, or identifier-based property lookup was used. No full parcel polygons were retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Campo Grande’s municipal government says SIMGEO integrates the municipal Cadastro Territorial Multifinalitário (CTM), its city data are georeferenced and made available to citizens, and the system supports the city’s property/infrastructure geographic information. This confirms a municipal territorial-cadastre function, but does not prove public access to a parcel-only geometry layer.
technicalBlocker: The municipal cadastre and geoprocessing system is confirmed. The public map route could not be inspected to a safe feature schema; no parcel polygon was requested or retained.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the current SIMGEO public viewer has a parcel geometry layer with a non-personal ID separable from tax/owner/address attributes, and whether that layer covers the WUP point.
nextStep: Retry only the official public map after the service is reachable; inspect item/layer metadata before any feature query and request geometry with a safe identifier only.

executedQueries.result: English and Portuguese searches found the official municipal SIMGEO portal and CTM description.
